name: Ishmael
bio: Ishmael son of Nethaniah, of the royal line of Judah, came to Gedaliah at Mizpah along with other army captains after Gedaliah was made governor over the remaining people of Judah. In the seventh month, Ishmael came with ten men and assassinated Gedaliah, along with the Jews and Chaldeans who were with him at Mizpah, prompting the people to flee to Egypt in fear of Babylonian reprisal (2 Kings 25:23-26).
